title: Bare credential prefixes and tokens cut short of the format's length
summary: A line listing bare prefixes (ghp_ gho_ ghu_ ghs_ ghr_ glpat- npm_ SG. xoxb-), and GITHUB_TOKEN, GITLAB_TOKEN and NPM_TOKEN assignments holding a prefix and six characters.
rationale: A prefix alone, or a value shorter than the format allows, is not an issued credential. Prefix-only matching produces a false alarm on every list of token types in documentation.

expectation.rationale: Not flagged. The values do not satisfy the documented length, so they are not credentials of those families.
